description: This file contains unit tests for TalkConfig parsing and fixture loading in the OpenClawKit project, including fixture data models, fixture loading logic, and test functions for selection and timeout configurations.

classes.name: TalkConfigContractFixture
classes.description: A decodable data structure representing fixture data for talk configuration tests, including selection and timeout cases.

classes.name: TalkConfigContractFixtureLoader
classes.description: A static utility for loading fixture data from a JSON file, with a method to find the fixture URL in the directory hierarchy.

classes.name: TalkConfigContractTests
classes.description: A test suite containing test functions to verify talk configuration selection and timeout logic using loaded fixtures.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and decodes the fixture JSON data into a TalkConfigContractFixture object.

methods.name: findFixtureURL
methods.description: Searches upward in the directory hierarchy from a starting URL to find the fixture JSON file.

methods.name: selectionFixtures
methods.description: Test method that iterates over selection case fixtures and verifies provider selection logic.

methods.name: timeoutFixtures
methods.description: Test method that verifies timeout configuration logic based on fixture data.
